from.place: proof: over a valuation ring, generic triviality implies triviality (Tag 0EX8)

title: Generic-fibre triviality over a valuation ring
statement: Let A be a valuation ring with fraction field K, let f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) be proper, flat, and of finite presentation [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let X_0 be its integral closed fibre [def-pc-integral-scheme], and let L be an invertible module on X [def-sc-invertible-module]. If H^0(X_K,\mathcal O_{X_K})=K and the restriction of L to the generic fibre X_K is trivial, then L is trivial on X.

proof.text: For a general valuation ring, properness and finite presentation make H^0(X,L) a finitely presented A-module. Flatness of X over A makes this module torsion free, so the valuation-ring finite-free lemma gives H^0(X,L) finite free. Flat base change identifies H^0(X,L) tensor_A K with H^0(X_K,L_K), which is K because L_K is trivial and H^0(X_K,O)=K; therefore H^0(X,L) has rank one. Choose a generator s.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 0EX8, general valuation-ring case through coherent cohomology and flat base change

proof.text: The restriction of s to the integral closed fibre X_0 is nonzero: otherwise the closed-fibre vanishing lemma gives a nonzero pi in the maximal ideal of A with s vanishing on X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}\operatorname{Spec}(A/\pi); since L is flat over A, multiplication by pi on L is injective with cokernel L/\pi L, so s=\pi t for a global section t, contradicting that s generates the free rank-one module H^0(X,L). By the zero-section relative-Cartier lemma, Z(s) is a relative effective Cartier divisor and is flat over A.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 0EX8, general valuation-ring case

proof.text: By the previous step Z(s)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) is flat. If Z(s) were nonempty, generizations lift along the flat morphism Z(s)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A), so the generic point of \operatorname{Spec}(A) would lie in its image and Z(s)_K would be nonempty, contradicting that s restricts to a trivialization on X_K. Thus Z(s) is empty and s is a global trivialization of L.
